fields.subject: Important information about your ondansetron prescription
body: The manufacturer has recalled two lots of the medicine we gave you on or after October 30. Small particles were found in samples of those lots.
We do not know of any patient harmed. We are writing so you can check your supply and decide with your prescriber what to do next.
whatToDo: Look at the lot number on your bottle or package. The recalled lots are EX-30417 and EX-30418.
If your lot is one of these, stop using the medicine and bring it back to the pharmacy.
If you have symptoms or questions about your health, call your prescriber or the poison control center.
If your lot is not one of these, you may keep using the medicine as directed.
fields.pharmacyActions: We have removed the lots from our shelves and will replace your medicine at no charge.
fields.hours: Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.
